To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the key factors of brand equity, including brand awareness, perceived quality, brand loyalty, have significant positive effects on consumer purchase goal in a mobile value-added service context.

personalization and identifiability are the two most important value proposition attributes that affect the key brand equity dimensions of perceived quality, brand loyalty, and brand awareness, which in turn influence consumer purchase goals.

the mobile service attribute of identifiability has a positive impact on perceived quality and brand loyalty; the mobile service attribute ‎of personalization has a positive impact ‎on brand awareness and perceived quality; and brand loyalty has a positive impact brand awareness and perceived brand quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a research model to investigate the relationship between mobile value-added services attributes and brand equity.
how the value proposition of mobile value-added ‎services affects the core brand equity factors and the consumer purchase goal in a mobile value-added service ‎context.
understanding the factors that influence the brand equity of mobile value-added ‎services and the relationships among these factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the findings of this study provide a better understanding of the factors that influence consumers’ adoption of mobile value-added ‎ services.
mobile value-added services can be used to increase brand equity, and thus increase the profitability of mobile service providers.
this study provides an empirical evidence of the relationships between the key value proposition attributes and the core brand equity factors in the context of the mobile services.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
brand equity is an important factor in the adoption of mobile services.
the mobile value-added services that have the highest perceived value to the consumer will be the most profitable.
mobile service providers should consider the value proposition attributes of personalization and identifiability as key elements of their mobile services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mobile value-added service provider should focus on the personalization, and ‎ identifiability ‎ attributes in order to build and maintain a positive brand equity.
mobile service providers can increase their value proposition by providing personalized and identifiable services to their customers, and by building a strong brand image.
mobile service providers should focus on the value proposition attributes that are more relevant to consumers' brand equity.
